login.title: Welcome to MoirAI
login.description: Sign in with your Discord account, or create an account to get started

signup.title: Choose your name
signup.description: Your username identifies you in MoirAI and cannot be changed later. Your display name is what other players see, and you can change it whenever you like.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Letters, numbers, underscores and periods. 2 to 32 characters.
username.invalid: Only letters, numbers, underscores and periods are allowed.
username.periods: Cannot contain two periods in a row.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.hint: What other players see. 2 to 32 characters. You can change this later.

notices.notRegistered: This Discord account doesn't have a MoirAI account yet. Sign up to create one.
notices.accountCreated: Your account was created. Welcome to MoirAI!
notices.accountDeleted: Your account and everything in it were deleted.

error.title: Authentication Failed
error.description: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again.
